title: Health and safety claims appear without an identifiable supporting-document route in the captured product state
observation: The captured Glucare Plus page states that it is suitable for people with diabetes, uses “Công thức y khoa ADDP”, and safely supports blood-glucose control; the captured link set exposes an ingredient anchor but no visible link labelled as a study, declaration, certification, or supporting document.

impact.user: A skeptical adult child cannot trace these high-stakes claims to supporting material from the captured product state.
impact.business: Unverifiable claim presentation can reduce trust for a health-related purchase.
impact.seo: Clear source and evidence links can improve entity and claim context.

suggested_direction: Place clearly labelled public supporting sources, product declarations, and appropriate-use boundaries next to the relevant claims.
unknowns: No judgment is made about medical validity, effectiveness, document authenticity, certification authenticity, or individual suitability.
A source may exist outside the captured page or selected scope.
persona_impact: An adult child researching for a parent needs to distinguish marketing claims from evidence shown or linked by the site.
limitations: Conclusion is limited to links and text in the captured browser state.

title: Product section mixes 9,000 VND and zero-price listings
observation: The captured product state lists a 1-package Glucare Plus item at 9,000 VND while other product cards in the same section expose 0 VND prices.

impact.user: The researcher cannot determine the actual package and purchase price for the zero-price items.
impact.business: Inconsistent visible price information weakens comparison and purchase confidence.

suggested_direction: Use explicit, consistent package and price labels; replace zero placeholders with a meaningful availability state.
unknowns: The capture does not establish backend price configuration or whether every listing represents the same package.
persona_impact: An adult child comparing options for a parent needs consistent product/package/price information.
limitations: No cart or checkout total was observed.
